name: Electric Motorcycle
description: A two- or three-wheeler with an electric motor that can exceed 28 mph on level ground and is road-legal under the licensing, registration and insurance rules for motorcycles.

restrictions.rule: Two or three wheels and an electric motor capable of more than 28 mph on level ground (HB 2021, 2026)
Ridden on public roads under the same licensing, registration and insurance requirements as a motorcycle (HB 2021, 2026)
Can't be ridden on a bike path, bike lane or any other path or roadway designated for bicycles (HB 2021, 2026)
Not an electric bicycle, whose motor is capped at 750 W and whose assistance stops by 28 mph
The definition applies only to the bicycle-facility ban; otherwise it is a motorcycle, or a motor-driven cycle at 5 horsepower (3,750 W) or less
One over 750 W that isn't registered for the road is a high-speed electric device, barred from every public road and area
